indication_area: Psychiatry (schizophrenia; adjunctive treatment of major depressive disorder; agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer's disease)
moa: Serotonin-dopamine activity modulator: partial agonist at 5-HT1A and dopamine D2 receptors, antagonist at 5-HT2A receptors

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 205422/Original-1 - Adjunctive Treatment of Major Depressive Disorder; NDA 205422/Original-2 - Treatment of Schizophrenia ... REXULTI (brexpiprazole) Tablets ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature dated 07/10/2015)

series_start_reason: Series starts at 2015Q3, the first quarter with sales: the REXULTI line prints a dash (nil) for the first half of 2015 (2Q 2016 FACT BOOK, 2016-08-09) and 2.3 for the nine months of 2015 (3Q 2016 FACT BOOK, 2016-11-11), and the FDA approval is dated 2015-07-10. FACT BOOKs before the 2Q 2019 edition print year-to-date columns only, so 2015Q3 to 2017Q4 (other than the three-month first quarters 2016Q1 and 2017Q1) are derived by subtraction; 2018Q1 is the three-month column of its own FACT BOOK. No Otsuka document read here dates the US launch quarter.
notes: One worldwide line printed as 'REXULTI/ RXULTI' (the second name is the EU brand), later 'REXULTI/ RXULTI (Core 2)'; the figures for earlier quarters are identical in every later FACT BOOK that repeats them (no restatement found). The total line is the sum of the Japan, North America (US, Canada), Europe and Others sub-rows printed beneath it (checked for every FACT BOOK from 2020-11-13 on whose sub-rows are machine-readable, within 0.35 billion yen). Values are in billions of yen with one decimal; the recorded value is that figure times 1,000 (millions of yen). The 2025-07-31 FACT BOOK (2Q 2025) has an unmapped-glyph text layer for the figures, so 2025Q2 is cited from the 2025-10-31 FACT BOOK. Full-year check: for every calendar year with four quarters whose full-year figure is printed in the following Q4 FACT BOOK (or, for 2023 onward in the later FACT BOOKs, the year columns), the four quarterly figures sum to the printed full year within 0.2 billion yen (rounding of one-decimal figures). From 2015Q3 to 2017Q4 the line has no regional sub-rows; it is the same worldwide line as later quarters because the 2017 full year (47.3) and 1Q 2018 (14.6) printed in the 2018 FACT BOOKs reappear unchanged in the 2019 FACT BOOKs, whose Japan, North America (US, Canada), EU and Others sub-rows add to the total (2018: 2.9 + 66.4 + 0.2 = 69.5 in the 2019-08-08 edition). Full-year check for the added years: 2015 2.3 + 2.3 = 4.6; 2016 4.4 + 7.2 + 8.5 + 9.7 = 29.8; 2017 10.1 + 11.3 + 12.7 + 13.2 = 47.3, each equal to the printed full year. Derived quarters are billions of yen with one decimal. Row labels: in the FACT BOOK layout the brand name is printed on the line below the figures (or, in some editions, the figures and brand share a line whose characters the text layer interleaves), so each row's row_label is the printed class heading on the figure line, the only label the figures can be matched under; a brand-named label was tried on every existing row and matched none of them. Scope composition changes (read from the 2Q 2019 and 4Q 2019 FACT BOOK quarterly-data tables, https://www.otsuka.com/en/ir/library/ documents 102135 and 102142): the sub-rows print Japan as a dash for 1Q 2018 and 1.1 (billion yen) for 2Q 2018, Europe as 0.1 for 1Q 2018 and 0.0 for the following quarters of 2018, and Others as nil until 4Q 2019 (0.0); so the 2015Q3 to 2018Q1 quarters are effectively North America (US, Canada) plus a negligible Europe amount, and Japan enters the worldwide line from 2018Q2. The pre-2018 sub-rows are not printed, so the early composition is inferred from the 2018 prior-year columns, not read for 2015 to 2017.
search_log: otsuka.com/en/ir/library/materials.html builds its document list in the browser from a JSON feed (https://ssl4.eir-parts.net/Custom/public/v5parts/4578/en/20210609/app/conf/common_conf.js names it as http://v4.eir-parts.net/V4Public/eir/4578/en/announcement/announcement_4.js, fetched over https); that feed lists 1,070 items; the 63 items titled 'FACT BOOK' (2011-02-14 to 2026-07-31, ir_material_for_fiscal_ym3) were all downloaded and read with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and pdftotext

the seven FACT BOOKs dated 2011-05-12 to 2012-11-13 yield no text from pdftotext (no text layer) and those dated 2013-02 to 2019-05 print year-to-date columns (3 months, 1H, 9 months, full year) with no quarterly table; the first FACT BOOK with a 'Pharmaceutical business <Reference> Quarterly Data' table is the one dated 2019-08-08 (2Q 2019). FACT BOOKs dated 2018-08, 2018-11 and 2025-07 have unmapped-glyph text layers for the figures; 2019-05 and 2022-02 split the digits of many figures with spaces

Quarterly values come from the quarterly-data table of each FACT BOOK: the last column is the FACT BOOK's own quarter and earlier columns are the prior-year and year-to-date quarters; where a quarter's own FACT BOOK was unreadable or lacked the line, the first later FACT BOOK that prints the quarter in a readable table is cited and the row's context says why

Otsuka's quarterly earnings release (Kessan Tanshin, TDnet) and the Financial Results Presentation were not used: the Tanshin prints year-to-date product sales in prose (for example the FY2025 one at https://fs2.magicalir.net/tdnet/2026/4578/20260213559778.pdf) and the FACT BOOK carries the single-quarter table
searched all 63 FACT BOOKs (pdftotext) for the brand name; the 'Sales of Major Products' tables name the brand from the 2013 editions on for Abilify Maintena and later for the others
FACT BOOK for 2Q 2026 (dated 2026-07-31) is the latest published at the time of the search; the Q3 2026 results are not yet released

FACT BOOKs dated 2015-02-13 to 2018-05-11 re-read with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) and pdftotext -layout: they print year-to-date columns (3 months, 1H, 9 months, full year), so single quarters before 2018Q2 are derived (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters, annual_less_reported_first_nine_months) from the editions whose lines carry the inputs; 1Q figures are printed as three-month columns in their own editions or as prior-year columns of the next year's 1Q edition; every derived row quotes the line it uses and states the other input and its edition.

REXULTI first-half 2015 cell in the FACT BOOK dated 2016-08-09 is a dash and the nine-months 2015 cell in the one dated 2016-11-11 is 2.3, so no sales are printed before 2015Q3; the FACT BOOKs dated 2015-08-07 and 2015-11-13 name REXULTI in the pipeline table only.

FACT BOOK dated 2017-05-12 (1Q 2017): pdfplumber text interleaves the characters of the row label, so 1Q 2017 (10.1) is cited from the prior-year column of the 1Q 2018 FACT BOOK (2018-05-11); pdftotext shows the same 10.1 in the 2017-05-12 edition.

Otsuka 'Financial Results' presentations (ir_material_for_fiscal_ym2, dated 2018-05-11, 2018-08-08, 2018-11-14, 2019-02-13, 2019-05-14, 2019-08-08, 2019-11-12, 2020-02-14) downloaded and searched with pdftotext: no per-product quarterly sales table for these products (NUEDEXTA is named only in narrative about the Avanir acquisition and a legal settlement in the 2018-05-11 and 2019-02-13 decks).
